questions.q: An ideal gas undergoes a cyclic transformation starting from the point A and coming back to the same point by tracing the path A→B→C→A as shown in the diagram. The total work done in the process is _____J.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Work done is given by area enclosed in the P vs V cyclic graph or V vs P cyclic graph

 Sign of work is positive for clockwise cyclic process for V vs P graph.

Work done in cyclic process = area inside the figure

W=12×(30-10)×(30-10)=200 kPa-dm3

=200×1000 Pa-L=2 L-bar=200 J

questions.q:
The number of endothermic process/es from the following is _______.

A. I2( g)→2I(g)

B. HCl(g)→H(g)+Cl(g)

C. H2O(l)→H2O(g)

D. C(s)+O2( g)→CO2( g)

E. Dissolution of ammonium chloride in water
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution: The decomposition reactions are endothermic reactions. The reactions I2( g)→2I(g) and HCl(g)→H(g)+Cl(g) are decomposition reactions. The heat vaporisation is an endothermic reaction. Hence, the conversion of H2Ol→H2Og is endothermic process. The heat of combustion is an exothermic process. The heat involved in C(s)+O2( g)⟶CO2( g) is heat of combustion. The dissolution of ammonium chloride in water is an endothermic process. NH4Cl(s)→NH4+(aq)+Cl−(aq); ΔH=+15. 1kJ/mol.

questions.q:
One mole of an ideal gas at 350 K is in a 2.0 L vessel of thermally conducting walls, which are in contact with the surroundings. It undergoes isothermal reversible expansion from 2.0 L to 3.0 L against a constant pressure of 4 atm. The change in entropy of the surroundings (∆S) is _____ J K–1 (Nearest integer)

Given: R=8.314 J K-1 mol-1.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The first law of thermodynamics for isothermal process Q=-W

The W for isothermal reversible process is

W=-nRTlnV2V1

∆S=QT

∆Ssurrounding=-nRlnV2V1

=-1×8.314×2.303×log32

=-3.37 JK-1

≃-3 JK-1

The given process is mentioned as isothermal reversible process hence the ∆Ssurrounding is calculated.

[Atomic mass off Fe is 55.85 u]

questions.solution:
T=298 K, R=8.314 JmolK

→ Chemical reaction is

Fe50g+2HCl→FeCl2P=1 bar+H2g

=5055.85 mol

→ Work done for 1 mol gas

=-Pext×ΔV

=ΔngRT

=-1×8.314×298 J

→ Work done for 5055.85 mol of gas

=-8.314×298×5055.85 J

=-2218.059 J

≃-2218 J

questions.q:
For independent process at 300 K.

Process ΔH/kJmol-1 ΔS/JK-1
A -25 -80
B -22 40
C 25 -50
D 22 20

The number of non-spontaneous process from the following is _____ .
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
The relation between change in Gibbs free energy, change in enthalpy and change in entropy can be written as follows,

ΔG=ΔH-TΔS

If ∆G is +ve , then the process is said to be non-spontaneous and if ∆G is -ve then the process is said to be spontaneous.

A:ΔGJmol-1=-25×103+80×300:-ve

B:ΔGJmol-1=-22×103-40×300:-ve

C:ΔGJmol-1=25×103+300×50;+ve

D:ΔGJmol-1=22×103-20×300:+ve

Processes C and D are non-spontaneous.

questions.q:
The molar heat capacity for an ideal gas at constant pressure is 20.785 J K-1 mol-1. The change in internal energy is 5000 J upon heating it from 300 K to 500 K. The number of moles of the gas at constant volume is____

(Given: R=8.314 J K-1 mol-1)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Molar specific heat capacity at constant pressure is defined as the amount of heat energy required to raise the temperature of one mole of a substance through 1K or 1°C at constant pressure. It is denoted by Cp,m.

Molar specific heat capacity at constant volume is defined as the amount of heat energy required to raise the temperature of one mole of a substance through 1K or 1°C at constant volume. It is denoted by Cv,m.

Cv,m=1n∆U∆T

Cp,m=Cv,m+R

⇒Cv,m=20.785-8.314=12.471 Jk-1ml-1

ΔU=nCv,mΔT

⇒n=500012.471×200=2512.471≈2
